comments.content:
[medium] This error message is out of date: per the PR description, class names are now mandatory in every checker method, yet the text still presents "check$$methodName" (no class name) as an acceptable format, which is no longer valid.

Please update it to:

```suggestion
                    "Checker method %s has incorrect name format: must be check$className$methodName or check$className$$methodName",
```

[medium] The `hasReceiver` field in `MethodKey` needs a decision: either rename it to `isInstance`, which more accurately describes its role in identifying nonstatic (instance) methods, or delete the field entirely, since it is unused dead code with no current references.
[low] Please confirm that `lastIndexOf("$$")` cannot cause duplicate work when this branch is revisited.
[low] A focused regression test for `MethodKey` would make this behavior safer to refactor.
